name: Proofread and edit diverse texts for accuracy
description: Users asked the AI assistant to proofread and edit diverse texts for errors in spelling, grammar, punctuation, and factual accuracy. The requests varied in scope, ranging from simple single-sentence corrections and restrictive style fixes (e.g., preserving original words) to comprehensive document reviews, OCR error corrections in multiple languages, and structural improvements such as splitting sentences or removing repetitions.
